{{Quote|Aunt Vel's been to Tassio Moon, look what she brought me.|Leida Mothma exclaims to Mon Mothma about her new dress from Tassio Moon|<ref name="Nobody Listening">{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}</ref>}}
'''Tassio Moon''' was a [[moon]] located in the [[Kuat sector]] of the [[Core Worlds]].<ref name="Appendix" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|109}}</ref> [[Vel Sartha]] claimed to have visited the moon before arriving at the [[Chandrilan Embassy]] on the<ref name="Nobody Listening" /> [[planet]]<ref name="Comprehensive">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Coruscant]]. There, she gifted [[Leida Mothma]], the daughter of her cousin [[Mon Mothma]], a [[Clothing|dress]] she brought from Tassio Moon.<ref name="Nobody Listening" />

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tassio Moon was mentioned in "[[Nobody's Listening!]],"<ref name="Nobody Listening" /> the ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''. The episode aired on [[November 2]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref>
